# Account Hub spinner layout uses shared padding without proving its clickable area

The native port spin box uses full block size and the input padding token; its arrows use half that padding instead of a fixed block size. Logical end radii and a lower border form the adopted visual compromise. Actual consumers are labeled bounded number inputs. The review still records large-font and unclickable-strip tradeoffs, so final acceptance and these CSS values do not establish target-size, zoom, focus or accessibility results. No rendering or manual steps ran.

Scope: Account Hub native port controls.
